relationship_to_previous_failed_interven: Prior rollbacks (R04, R08_v2, R10_v2, R12_v2, R14_v2, R17_v2) and the heterogeneous experiment families are not independent replicates and do not isolate a single operator effect; they are recorded on a reused prior pool and cannot be aggregated into a causal operator claim. scientific_hypothesis: The frozen pointwise local-motif guidance (R15_v2, region F_b011_s030__reference) will retain its measured formation behavior on the larger/new prior pool and, on native completion, will not degrade the frozen tail utility relative to the matched unguided pool. Formation is treated as a mechanism, not as terminal success; the primary outcome is the frozen tail utility with the affinity mean as guard.
